0.0: Ah! There might be a way! If you utilize the Thorny Vine that we'd planted for the protection of our castle, you just might be able to enter the castle's premises!
0.1: If you can just get rid of the thorns on the vines, you should be able to climb up and get over the castle walls. In order to do that though, you'll need Thorn Remover...

yes.0: #b#t2430015##k can be crafted with the extracts of the Mysterious Medicine in El Nath. King Pepe once used this medicine to poison the pigs and invade the Mushroom Forest.
yes.1: You should be able to obtain the medicinal extracts from #b#t4000501##k. Eliminate #r#o3300002##k in #b#m106020401##k, obtain #b30 #t4000501##k, and bring them to the #bSecretary of Magic#k.

no.0: This is your only hope of entering the castle. Please think it through and come back to see me if you change your mind.

1.0: You need a #b#t2430015##k? It's not like I can just go down to the store and pick that up! You need to bring me the materials and even then, it's going to take a heck of a lot of time!

yes.0: Hmmm, so this is the tail of a pig that was intoxicated by the magic herbs found in the highlands, eh? I can't believe King Pepe controlled his monsters with this... Anyway, you should extract its concentrate, and then use spells to purify the extract.

npc.0: Gather #b30 #t4000501#s#k, then take them over to #b#p1300004##k.

item.0: You want me to make the #b#t2430015##k or not? Bring me a #b#t4000501#s#k, or #b30#k, from the #r#o3300002##k in #b#m106020401##k.
